demos.name: Open London 3D Drive
demos.summary: Browser-based 3D urban navigation through Westminster to Trafalgar Square. Automated drive simulation with 5 camera modes, 4 lighting presets, and real-time performance monitoring.
demos.description: An interactive 3D urban drive experience through central London using open data from OpenStreetMap. Features automated route following, camera modes (driver, chase, orbit, pedestrian, overview), dawn/day/dusk/night lighting, and performance metrics panel — all running in the browser without proprietary APIs.
demos.title: Open London 3D Drive

demos.name: Open London 3D Drive (Implementation)
demos.summary: Full-stack implementation repository for the London 3D drive — data pipeline, processing, Docker deployment, and web application source.
demos.description: The engineering implementation behind the London 3D showcase. Contains the Python data acquisition pipeline (Overpass API fetch), geo-processing scripts, the Vite + TypeScript web application, and Docker Compose deployment configuration. This is the development/implementation counterpart to the showcase repo.
demos.title: Open London 3D Drive (Implementation)
